name: Deeds of Flesh
description: '''Deeds of Flesh''' is an American [[brutal death metal]] band from [[Los Osos, California|Los Osos]], California, U.S. They were formed in 1993 by Jacoby Kingston, Erik Lindmark (1972–2018) and Joey Heaslet. They founded the label Unique Leader Records, which has become home to a number of [[death metal]] bands from around the world.  Deeds of Flesh have released nine studio albums. Their most recent, ''[[Nucleus (Deeds of Flesh album)|Nucleus]]'', was released in 2020.
